name: Bircher Muesli
steps: Mix oats, milk and yogurt in a covered bowl; refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight until the oats soften.
Grate half the apple and toss it with lemon juice to prevent browning. Stir it into the soaked oats.
If the mixture is very thick, loosen with a little milk. Divide among four bowls.
Slice the remaining apple, then top the bowls with apple, chopped almonds and berries. Serve cold.
tips: Add crunchy nuts and fruit only at serving time.
passiveTime: Chill overnight or for at least 4 hours.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
